````text
# #4938: Patch: give the Jlockeed-Unit pool a named function and call it from Headquarters
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

One card fills the board with random Jlockeed Units. Its script hand-writes that pool's query, and its test hand-keeps the nine-id answer list. Both are correct today, but when the tenth Jlockeed Unit ships both rot by hand. This names the pool once, where all pools live, and calls it from both places.

## Why

crates/cards/README.md (section 3) requires that a pool the spec would otherwise list card by card is a named function in src/query.rs plus a POOLS row, and that a script drawing from such a pool calls its function rather than writing the query inline. `jlockeed_cards()` (src/query.rs) covers all Jlockeed cards, but nothing narrows it to Units, so Headquarters keeps a local `fn jlockeed_units` (crates/cards/src/scripts/meditative/c097_9_jlockeeds_headquarters.rs:23-25) and its test `r380_the_jlockeed_units_of_the_sets_that_ship_are_the_nine_the_tests_name` re-implements the filter over the catalog beside a hand-kept nine-id `JLOCKEED_UNITS` list (:169-184).

## Proposal

Add `jlockeed_units()` (Unit-narrowed, same shipped-set and token defaults) plus a POOLS row so the next daily fold lists it in spec/CARDS.md; the script calls it; the test derives its expected members from the pool function instead of the hand-kept list. Leave CARDS.md itself alone.

## Where it lands

crates/cards/src/query.rs (new function + POOLS row) and crates/cards/src/scripts/meditative/c097_9_jlockeeds_headquarters.rs (script + test). No hand edits to generated files.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Script contains no inline Jlockeed query; test derives expected members from the pool function, not a hand-kept id list
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-cards c097_9` and the cross query tests green
- [ ] `cargo jackioh spec check` green with CARDS.md untouched

## Size and risks

S. Test-churn only; no behavior change. The only risk is the POOLS/CARDS.md plumbing, contained by leaving the generated file to the daily fold.

## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/45664348162)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Name the Jlockeed-Unit pool once as `jlockeed_units()` in `crates/cards/src/query.rs` with a `POOLS` row, call it from the Headquarters script instead of the hand-written query, and derive the script test's expected members from that function instead of the hand-kept nine-id list. No behavior change; `spec/CARDS.md` is left for the daily fold.

## Files to touch

| File | New / change | What changes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `crates/cards/src/query.rs` | change | Add `pub fn jlockeed_units()` after `jlockeed_cards()`; add `jlockeed-units` row to `POOLS` after the `jlockeed` row |
| `crates/cards/src/scripts/meditative/c097_9_jlockeeds_headquarters.rs` | change | Delete local `fn jlockeed_units`; call `crate::query::jlockeed_units()` in `fill()`; replace `JLOCKEED_UNITS` const with a pool-derived helper and rewrite `r380_the_jlockeed_units_of_the_sets_that_ship_are_the_nine_the_tests_name` plus the membership asserts |

Must not touch: `spec/CARDS.md`, `spec/INDEX.md`, `spec/history/`, `spec/pending/`, anything under `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, `crates/engine/`, `crates/ai/`, `apps/web/`, or any other card script. Governing spec: §5.1 (the query), §8.8 row 97.9, R278 (Jlockeed pool), R380/R1420 (non-token, sets that ship), R387 (generator excluded); contract: `crates/cards/README.md` §3 and `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` §6 (named pool + `POOLS` row, script calls the function).

## Steps

1. In `crates/cards/src/query.rs`, after `jlockeed_cards()` (ends line 93), add:
   ```rust
   /// R278: "random Jlockeed Units" (M #97.9 Jlockeed's Headquarters): the Units of `jlockeed_cards`,
   /// every non-token card tagged Jlockeed narrowed to Units, from the sets that ship (R380, R1420).
   pub fn jlockeed_units() -> CardQuery {
       CardQuery {
           type_: Some(OneOrMany::One(CardType::Unit)),
           ..jlockeed_cards()
       }
   }
   ```
   Copy the doc-comment style of `jlockeed_cards()` (ruling + callers + token/set defaults). `CardType`, `OneOrMany`, `Tag`, `CardQuery` are already imported (lines 13–21). The `..jlockeed_cards()` struct update (pattern: `crates/cards/src/scripts/meditative_plus/c004_supply_drop.rs:94-97`) keeps shipped-set and token defaults identical by construction.
2. In the same file's `POOLS`, directly after the `jlockeed` row (lines 228–233), add:
   ```rust
   NamedPool {
       name: "jlockeed-units",
       rule: "The Jlockeed Units (R278): every non-token Unit tagged Jlockeed, from the sets that ship (R380, R1420).",
       call: "jlockeed_units",
       parts: || whole(jlockeed_units()),
   },
   ```
   Keep kebab-case (`starship-pieces` pattern) and the `whole(...)` single-part shape. Do not run `cargo jackioh spec index`; do not edit `spec/CARDS.md`.
3. In `crates/cards/src/scripts/meditative/c097_9_jlockeeds_headquarters.rs`, delete the local pool (lines 22–25: doc comment plus `fn jlockeed_units() -> Value { json!({ "type": "Unit", "tags": ["Jlockeed"] }) }`). In `fill()` line 42 change `"query": jlockeed_units()` to `"query": crate::query::jlockeed_units()` (pattern: `crates/cards/src/scripts/classic_plus/c048_jlockeeds_lobbyist.rs:25`). The `json!` macro serializes the returned `CardQuery` as today; leave `"lane"` and `"radiant"` args alone. Update the file header `Engine:` comment to name `` `crate::query::jlockeed_units` `` (spec/CARDS.md lists it, #3804) instead of describing the inline query.
4. In the same file's `mod tests`: delete `const JLOCKEED_UNITS: [&str; 9]` (lines 83–96) and add:
   ```rust
   fn expected_jlockeed_units() -> Vec<String> {
       crate::query::pool_ids(&crate::query::jlockeed_units())
   }
   ```
   Rewrite `r380_the_jlockeed_units_of_the_sets_that_ship_are_the_nine_the_tests_name` (lines 168–182) to keep its independent catalog filter (Unit, non-token, `Tag::Jlockeed`, `set_ships`) as the oracle but assert it equals `expected_jlockeed_units()` instead of the deleted const — this proves the new function matches the rule with no hand list. Replace every other `JLOCKEED_UNITS` use (membership asserts ~lines 216, 236, 242; `seen` loop ~line 240; radiant assert ~line 316) with `expected_jlockeed_units()` (e.g. `assert!(expected_jlockeed_units().contains(&unit.def_id))`, iterate `for unit in expected_jlockeed_units()`). Keep the test's `r380_…` name.
5. Run the checks in **Tests** below; confirm `git status` shows `spec/CARDS.md` unmodified.

## Tests

- Existing card tests, updated in place (no new test names; the `r380_…` test now fails if `jlockeed_units()` drifts from the Unit-narrowed rule, and the fill/radiant tests fail if the script stops drawing from it): `cargo test -p jackioh-cards c097_9`.
- Cross query tests, unmodified (the hardcoded five-pool loop in `crates/cards/tests/cross/query.rs` still passes; the new row is covered by the card test): `cargo test -p jackioh-cards --test cards query`.
- Spec graph with generated file untouched: `cargo jackioh spec check` plus `git status --porcelain -- spec/CARDS.md` empty.
- Style gates: `cargo fmt --check`; `cargo clippy -p jackioh-cards --all-targets -- -D warnings`.

## Done when

- [ ] Script has no inline Jlockeed query and no local `fn jlockeed_units`; its only pool reference is `crate::query::jlockeed_units()`.
- [ ] Test file has no hand-kept id list; expectations come from `crate::query::jlockeed_units()` / `pool_ids`.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-cards c097_9` and the cross query tests pass.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh spec check` passes with `spec/CARDS.md` untouched; fmt and clippy gates pass.

## Risks

- `spec check` resolving `[[CARDS#…]]` links: safe — `crates/tools/src/spec_cards.rs` builds headings live from `POOLS`, so the new heading exists before the daily fold rewrites `CARDS.md`; leaving the generated file alone is the contained path.
- Drawn-by detection (`spec_cards.rs:15-17`) blanks comments/strings and reads code above `#[cfg(test)]`: safe as long as the `crate::query::jlockeed_units()` call sits in `fill()`, not only in tests.
- Purity (rule 4) and card-script purity (rule 5): safe — the new function builds and returns a `CardQuery` value only; the script still returns effects via `summon_random`.
- Judge's note (weakened nine-id pin): accepted trade-off per the issue; the `r380` test keeps the independent catalog filter as oracle, so a wrong tenth Unit still fails there rather than passing tautologically.

## Open questions

None.
````
